name: imap-mcp
description: Connects any IMAP mailbox — iCloud, Gmail, Outlook, Fastmail, university or company mail — to your second brain. Read-only unless you explicitly enable drafts and mailbox management, and it can never send or permanently delete.

account.title: Email address
account.description: The address you sign in with. This is your IMAP username.

provider.title: Mail provider
provider.description: icloud, gmail, outlook, fastmail, or generic.

imap_host.title: IMAP host (generic only)
imap_host.description: Only needed when provider is generic, e.g. mail.your-university.edu

vault_root.title: Vault folder
vault_root.description: Where synced mail is written as notes.

enable_writes.title: Allow writing to the mailbox
enable_writes.description: Leave empty for read-only. Set to 1 to add drafts, delete (to Trash), archive, move, and mark read. Deleting never destroys mail and nothing is ever sent.
